messages:
Anna Patel: quick sync — we need to lock priorities for the Optimize toolkit for the next release (batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). customers are asking for a combo of cost + quality controls. how do we sequence? :thinking_face:
Ben Cho: agree we should prioritize in a way that minimizes infra churn. batching + simple KV prefix cache first. quant recs are higher risk (model regressions). eval-alerts could be lightweight (signal only) initially.
Li Zhang: technical note: quantization recommendations must be per-model profile + workload sim. otherwise we get surprising quality drops. we should ship an "opt-sim" runner to run a small eval sweep before recommending.
María Gonzalez: from a product/launch POV — customers want clear acceptance criteria. propose: 1) canary serving on Dedicated for 2 weeks, 2) regression delta < 1% for quality evals on key prompts, 3) latency SLO degradation < 10% for tail p99.
Kevin O'Neal: CS signals: two pilot customers want eval-trigger rules that can alert on quality drift and auto-suggest rollback. one customer (healthcare) also needs KMS + audit logs for any recommend/auto-apply flow. they asked for a demo by end of next month.
Ben Cho: implementation thoughts:
- batching: start with continuous batching + dynamic batch-size tuning (low risk)
- caching: prefix KV cache + TTL config per-route
- quant recs: run candidate quant ops on shadow runner, collect eval metrics, then surface recommendations in console
- eval-alerts: rule engine that watches eval metrics and fires webhooks / slack / console alerts
Example alert config snippet:```yaml
alert_name: prompt_set_drift
trigger: eval_metric.delta > 0.03
actions:
  - type: webhook
  - type: console_notification
```
Li Zhang: +1 to shadow runner. add a small randomized A/B flip to verify real traffic impact before any auto-apply.
María Gonzalez: launch gating checklist draft: docs + quickstart, sample alert templates, migration guide for existing batching configs, canary dashboard, rollback playbook. needs PM + Docs + SE signoff.
Anna Patel: prioritization proposal: MVP (6 weeks) = batching improvements + KV cache + basic quant recommender (read-only, no auto-apply) + eval-alerts (monitoring only). Beta (next 8 weeks) = quant auto-sim + recommendation UI + rule authoring + webhook actions. GA = auto-apply workflows + enterprise audit/KMS support. thoughts? :thumbsup:
Kevin O'Neal: customers will accept that sequencing. ask: can we offer a pilot program for the healthcare customer to test audit + KMS early in Beta?
Ben Cho: technical caveat: KMS + private deploy touches infra/security — needs eng-sec signoff. but we can scope an integration spike in Beta.
María Gonzalez: I'll draft the checklist and sample alert templates today and share in this thread.
opt-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync tomorrow 09:30 — add this as a topic.
Anna Patel: action items: Ben to draft architecture notes + spike plan for quant sim (EOD Tue), Li to list required eval workloads (EOD Mon), María to draft launch checklist & alert templates (EOD today), Kevin to confirm pilot customer availability. I'll pull this into the roadmap doc once we have Ben's spike plan. Thanks all :rocket:
